source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to 13C NMR spectroscopy (PDF 212).

blocks.text: 12C nucleus ki koi magnetic khasiyat nahi, kyunke is ke protons aur neutrons dono juft hain, is liye yeh NMR inactive hai. 13C nucleus ka neutrons ki taaq tadaad ki wajah se magnetic spin hai, is liye carbon compounds ke 13C NMR spectra liye ja sakte hain. 1H NMR ki tarah chemical shift (delta, ppm mein) 0.0 ppm wale TMS se napi jati hai, lekin 13C ki had 0-220 ppm hai. Deuterated chloroform, CDCl3, aam taur par solvent hai; yeh taqreeban 77 ppm par apna chhota signal deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CDCl3 ka chhota signal taqreeban 80 ppm par aata hai. Asal mein CDCl3 ka 13C signal taqreeban 77 ppm par hai (77.2 ppm par teen chhoti peaks). Is liye sabaq 77 ppm likhta hai.

blocks.prompt: 12C NMR signal kyun nahi deta jab ke 13C deta hai?
blocks.explanation: 12C ke protons aur neutrons dono juft hain, is liye is ka nuclear spin nahi; 13C ke neutrons taaq hain, is liye is ka spin hai.

items: 13C shifts TMS se 0-220 ppm; CDCl3 aam solvent.
